subject: MSA: security exhibit, evidence cadence, and pen-test scheduling
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@novusbio.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@novusbio.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: security exhibit clarifications & audit cadence for MSA/OF

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Novus is excited about the performance numbers. Legal did an initial pass on the MSA + order form and we have a few security-related asks before we can move the orderform into procurement:

- We redlined the security exhibit to request a 30-day advance notice for any onsite or remote audit and the right to limit scope to our customer data only.
- We need confirmation of SOC 2 Type II availability and what supporting artifacts Redwood will provide (control mappings, sampling windows, remediation evidence).
- Pen-test language: Novus requires a customer-facing summary of findings and a window for Novus to review remediation before publication. We also need a proposed pen-test window so internal infra teams can schedule change freezes.
- Evidence cadence: procurement requests a monthly evidence drop for the first 90 days after go-live, then quarterly thereafter (we included an initial checklist).

Attaching: Novus_Security_Checklist.xlsx (stub). Can you propose a pragmatic evidence cadence and clarify the auditor access model? Also copy in your legal/security folks so we can converge on redlines this week.

Appreciate it — Sara
Sara Liu
Head of IT Security, Novus Biotech

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@novusbio.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@novusbio.com>
Cc: Chris Park <c.park@thirdpartysec.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T13:18:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: security exhibit clarifications & audit cadence for MSA/OF

Sara — thanks for the clear summary and checklist. I’ve looped in our legal and security teams and sketched a practical path forward below.

Quick answer highlights (proposal):
- SOC 2: We will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a controlled set of supporting artifacts (control narrative, sample evidence excerpts) via a secure link within 10 business days of request. Full forensic-level evidence will be produced under a scoped engagement.
- Pen test: proposed remote pen-test window Aug 16–20. Redwood will provide a customer-facing executive summary and remediation timeline; we can accommodate a short review period (7 business days) before any public release.
- Auditor access & scope: we can accept audits that are scoped to Redwood-hosted systems that directly process Novus workloads. We cannot permit broad, live, invasive scans against production systems without an agreed sandbox and NDA; we will propose a pre-approved checklist for what auditors may access.
- Evidence cadence: biweekly evidence drops for the first 30 days post-activation (to accelerate onboarding checks), then monthly for the remainder of the first quarter, then quarterly ongoing. We can compress cadence if Novus needs faster ramp.

I attached a draft security exhibit (security-exhibit-draft-v1.pdf) with the above language for your review. If this looks directionally OK I’ll open an internal review with legal to finalize redlines and share a mutual action plan + DocuSign link for the order form.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether Novus requires on-site access or if remote/signed-evidence is acceptable?
2) Confirm pen-test window preference (Aug 16–20 or propose alternative).
3) Approve the proposed evidence cadence or provide preferred cadence.

I’ll follow up internally immediately so we can get legal redlines over to you by 7/23.

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: security-exhibit-draft-v1.pdf (stub)
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Request: security exhibit clarifications & audit cadence for MSA/OF — action + timeline (deal D-78321)

Team — forwarding Novus’ asks (below). They’ve shared a checklist and want us to converge on redlines this week. Quick summary and proposed internal positions:

1) SOC 2 availability: propose commit to provide SOC 2 Type II report + limited supporting artifacts via secure link within 10 business days of request. Push back on ad-hoc forensic exports unless under a scoped engagement.

2) Audit access: accept remote/signed evidence; allow remote interviews and log exports under an agreed scope. Decline broad live testing against prod without sandbox/NDA. Accept 30-day pre-notification for audits (can be reduced to 15 days for renewals) — Novus requested 30.

3) Pen-test: propose Aug 16–20 as the first window. We should require a rules-of-engagement doc, and reserve the right to require a rollback/change freeze schedule. Novus asks for a customer-facing summary of findings and 7-day review window before publication — reasonable.

4) Evidence cadence: suggest biweekly for initial 30 days, monthly for first quarter, then quarterly. Monica, can you own the initial evidence drops and be the point for Novus?

Attachments: I’ve attached the current orderform draft (orderform-draft.docx) so you can see the clauses we’re negotiating.

Ask: please send any redline suggestions and the preferred legal language by 2027-07-23 11:00 PT so I can consolidate and send back to Novus. I’ll also prepare a short mutual action plan and DocuSign link after we align.

Thanks — Alex

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-23T09:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: security exhibit clarifications & audit cadence for MSA/OF — suggested redlines

Alex / team — flagged language below we should propose to Novus. I ran this by Product Security and Legal and included operational constraints.

Proposed redlines (high level):
- SOC 2 access: "Redwood will provide its most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a limited set of supporting control artifacts (control narratives, sample log excerpts, change tickets) within 10 business days of a written request from the customer. Where additional evidence is required beyond those artifacts, Redwood will accommodate production of such evidence under a mutually-agreed, scoped engagement and with reasonable notice."

- Audit rights & scope: "Customer and customer's auditor may perform audits limited to the services and data streams that directly process Customer workloads. Redwood will require 30 days' prior written notice for all audit activities. Live, intrusive testing against production systems is prohibited unless executed within an agreed sandbox environment and under a separate engagement with defined ROE (rules of engagement)."

- Pen-test: "Redwood will schedule a remote penetration test in the mutually-agreed window; Redwood will publish an executive summary of findings to the customer and provide a 7-business-day review period prior to any external release. Redwood will provide proposed windows and require minimum 10 business days' notice for the customer to prepare change freezes."

- Evidence cadence: "Initial onboarding evidence will be provided biweekly for the first 30 days after activation, then monthly for the remainder of the first 90 days, and quarterly thereafter. Exceptions for specific artifacts (e.g., full forensic logs) require scoped agreements."

Operational notes / owners:
- Monica: evidence lead & first point for submissions to Novus (will coordinate infra pulls).
- Karthik: legal redline owner on clause references (esp. the audit scope & NDA language).
- Laura: commercial to confirm there's no commercial impact in limiting on-site auditor access and to approve timing for order form finalization.

Attachments: SOC2-excerpt.txt (stub), pen-test-ops-notes.pdf (stub)

I can send these suggested redlines to Novus once Karthik signs off. If legal wants firmer wording on notice periods or remediation SLAs, call it out.

— Monica
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@novusbio.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@novusbio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Chris Park <c.park@thirdpartysec.com>
Date: 2027-07-23T14:12:00-04:00
Subject: Next steps: agreement on security exhibit language + DocuSign and pen-test windows (D-78321)

Sara / Tom — thanks for the checklist and for the quick turnaround. Monica and the legal team proposed targeted redlines (summary below) and operational owners; we believe this will address Novus' concerns while preserving acceptable operational constraints for Redwood.

Summary of the agreed approach (proposed):
- SOC 2: Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II report + control artifacts within 10 business days of written request. Further evidence produced under scoped engagement.
- Audit access: Audits limited to services processing Novus data; 30 days' notice; no broad intrusive live testing without sandbox/NDA and ROE.
- Pen-test: propose first remote window Aug 16–20. Redwood provides executive summary; Novus gets a 7-business-day review before any external release.
- Evidence cadence: biweekly for first 30 days after activation, monthly through the first 90 days, then quarterly. Monica will be the evidence owner.

Action items:
- Novus: confirm acceptance of the above or provide a single consolidated counter-proposal by 2027-07-26 EOD PT.
- Redwood: prepare DocuSign order form with agreed security exhibit and circulate (I will send link once legal signs off).
- Pen-test: Novus to confirm preferred window (we propose Aug 16–20) and share ROE or contact for third-party tester (cc Chris Park).

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/novus-orderform-D78321
Mutual action plan (attached): mutual-action-plan.csv (stub)

Would you like to schedule a 30-minute sync early next week (Aug 2–3) to finalize the order form and pen-test scheduling? I can book a meeting once we get confirmation on the items above.

Thanks, and please let us know any redlines you need us to take back to Legal.

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
